headword: {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}

definitions.explanation: Artificially produced sounds used in film, theater, television, and other media to enhance the experience. Can also refer to the acoustic properties or sound quality of a space.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すばらしい。
examples.english: The sound effects in this movie are wonderful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for staff to handle the stage sound effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最大限|さいだいげん}→最大限：13071_saidaigen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This concert hall is designed to maximize its acoustic effects.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧ ('sound; acoustics') and ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ ('effect'). Has two related uses: (1) artificially created sounds for media production, and (2) the acoustic quality or resonance of a physical space.

USAGE:
- In film/theater contexts, refers to the craft of creating and mixing sound effects
- In architecture/venue contexts, refers to how well a space carries and enhances sound
- The person responsible for sound effects is called {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ or simply ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧さん

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add sound effects
- {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: sound effects staff
- {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to have excellent acoustics
- {音響効果|おんきょうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to enhance the acoustic effects

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{効果音|こうかおん}→効果音：11924_koukaon⟧: sound effect — a specific individual sound effect (e.g., a doorbell, explosion), more common in everyday usage
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧: sound; acoustics — the broader field; used alone it can mean audio/sound in general
- {BGM|ビージーエム}: background music — continuous music underlying a scene, as opposed to punctual sound effects
